The vectors do something, and it is theirs. Steering scores 0.75 against a baseline of 0.08, wins 20 against the matched no-op's 7, and zeroing or randomising them returns the score to 0.06 -- so the movement is carried by these directions and not by the hooks being present. Nothing regresses.

Two requirements stand, and neither is a defect in the rig. Permuting the vectors among the same four layers still scores 0.44, so which layer holds which vector is not load-bearing and the specificity control is right to say so. And asking in words moves the score further than steering does, 1.36 against 0.75, which is the bar a vector has to clear to be worth serving at all.

Serving authority stays refused. At alpha 0.4 this same measurement returned treatment 6 against a no-op 6; the alpha sweep beside this file is why.
